title: Transit Timing Variations of Exoplanet WASP-4b: Decrease in the Orbital Period

contributions.purpose: 建可复现的凌星计时管线并给真实误差
contributions.mechanism: Mandel-Agol 限暗模型拟合逐凌中点+有限差分 Jacobian 把形态参数协方差传入计时方差
contributions.evaluation: 58 个 TESS 逐凌中点(σ≈0.0006-0.0009 d),误差经 J CθJ^T 膨胀
contributions.domain: 系外行星凌星计时/潮汐耗散
contributions.source_quote: a transparent timing pipeline with uncertainty propagation from transit morphology

contributions.purpose: 检验轨道周期是否衰减
contributions.mechanism: 合并 4 个 TESS sector+12 条文献计时(回溯 2008)做线性 vs 二次历表 WLS+BIC 选择
contributions.evaluation: 二次历表决定性占优 ΔBIC≈313(χ² 479.66→161.98),Ṗ=-13.77±0.77 ms/yr,衰减时标 P/|Ṗ|≈8.4e6 yr
contributions.source_quote: A quadratic ephemeris is decisively favored over a constant-period model (∆BIC≈313), yielding a negative period derivative of Ṗ= -13.77 ±0.77 ms yr−1

contributions.mechanism: sector jackknife、σ 膨胀 30%、SAP vs PDCSAP 三项鲁棒性检查
contributions.evaluation: 三项均不改变二次历表偏好(差异 <0.2σ);次食深度 52±54 ppm 不显著
contributions.source_quote: Robustness checks (sector jackknifes, timing-error inflation, and SAP vs. PDCSAP photometry) leave the preference for a quadratic ephemeris intact.

self_declared_provenance.quote: This work provides a reproducible re-analysis focused on four TESS sectors (2, 28, 29, 69) combined with non-TESS timings from the literature.

notes: 质量高:具名作者(Longhitano/Shporer/Drori),真实公开 TESS 数据+可复现 notebook。诚实区分"测量"(周期减少 13.77 ms/yr)与"解释"(潮汐衰减 vs Rømer 加速/伴星,社区仍有争议),不过度诠释;主动报告次食不显著。checklist AI 披露 [C] Mostly AI, assisted by human,残留 Colab-only 等 AI 局限。accept。
